work_class:
NEW CONSTRUCTION -- New Building for Meals on Wheels Central Maryland Headquarters. The property is located at two rear parcels which will be subdivided from a larger existing property at 4404 Edmondson Avenue. The bulk of the new construction is on Parcel 1, zoned C-3, with limited sitework on Parcel 2, zoned R-5. Addresses will be created for the properties after the subdivision process is completed in March 2026. The project site is located at 701 Swann Avenue, Baltimore, Maryland 21229. All work as per plans and as per code.

The bulk of the new construction is on Parcel 1, zoned C-3, with limited sitework on Parcel 2, zoned R-5. Addresses will be created for the properties after the subdivision process is completed in March 2026.
Meals on Wheels of Central Maryland (MOWCM) is one of the largest and oldest continuously operating, non-profit, home-delivered meal programs in the United States with a mission to enable people to live independently at home through the provision of nutritious meals, personal contact and related services. Meals on Wheels of Central Maryland has outgrown their current 16,000 SF building in East Baltimore. To continue to serve the mission, a new expanded facility will be constructed in West Baltimore that will serve as the new headquarters for Meals on Wheels of Central Maryland. The project site is located at 701 Swann Avenue, Baltimore, Maryland 21229, at rear parcels behind the Edmondson Village Shopping Center that exist as an abandoned parking lot. 
The new home for Meals on Wheels of Central Maryland celebrates and communicates its mission through purpose-driven design that optimizes organizational and food production functionality. The project will consist of: ******

SCOPE OF WORK:
 
 ---- NEW CONSTRUCTION  ------
 - site demolition, site development, and a new construction building; the building is centrally located on the site and consists of approximately
 - 41,000 GSF of office and 
 - food service facilities with an approximately
 - 3,000 GSF exterior covered van loading dock at the East and North sides of the building, and 
 - three solar canopies in the east parking area.

AS PER PLANS AND AS PER CODE.

 ******* SEPARATE PERMIT REQUIRED FOR SPRINKLERS *****

work_class: .During an on-site consultation conducted on June 3, 2026, the inspector noted that the approved permit drawings show 2x10 roof rafters, while the roof was framed with 2x6 rafters. The inspector advised that the roof framing would need to be modified or otherwise supported to address the span of the existing 2x6 rafters.    In response, revised drawings were prepared showing the addition of a perpendicular mid-span support beam and supporting posts. The proposed modification is intended to reduce the effective span of the existing 2x6 rafters and address the framing concern identified during the consultation while maintaining the overall roof design.    This amendment is submitted for review and approval of the revised roof framing configuration. Separate permit will be required for electrical, mechanical, and plumbing work. As per plans and as per code.

project: Office - 100 LIGHT ST
work_class:
1.	Survey and develop Design Drawings for Permitting and Installation.
2.	Receive Owner sign off on plans and coordination before proceeding.
3.	Pull Permits as necessary.
4.	Provide and Install (3) 400A Fuses in existing Rail Lights East Disconnect in MDP.
5.	Provide and Install (2) 2” EMT Conduits from existing Disconnect in MDP to wall designated for Charger locations during Site walk.
6.	Provide and Install 1 Set (3) 3/0 and (1) #4 Ground from Disconnect in MDP in each 2” pipe to new 400A Panel located adjacent to Chargers.
7.	Provide and Install (1) 208V 400A MCB 3R Panel with (10) 40A 2P Breakers.
8.	Provide and install (5) 1” EMT Pipes each from Panel to (10) 32A Chargers wall mounted with Cord Management. 
9.	Provide and Install (4) #8 THHN and (1) #10 THHN Ground from Panel to Chargers in each Pipe installed above. One 1” pipe will serve (2) Chargers.
10.	Terminate wire in Disconnect and Panel.
11.	Provide, Mount, and Terminate Chargers as described above.
12.	Provide and Install (10) Wrap Around Bollards at Chargers and (2) at New Panel.
13.	Receive Final Inspections and Sign Off.
14.	Power up and Commission all provided Equipment.
15.	Provide full Demonstration to Customer.

As per plans as per code.

work_class:
THE PROJECT INVOLVES A FULL INTERIOR DEMOLITION AND GUT REHABILITATION. ALL EXISTING WALLS AND DOORS WILL BE REMOVED, AND EVERY COMPONENT WILL BE REPLACED.
INTERIOR ALTERATIONS TO INCLUDE: INTERIOR DEMOLITION (CATEGORY I), INCLUDING REMOVAL OF THE CEILING, NON-STRUCTURAL WALLS, DOORS, AND ALL ASSOCIATED DEBRIS. FRAMING TO CREATE NEW PARTITION WALLS, INSTALLATION OF NEW INSULATION, NEW TRIM, NEW HARDWOOD FLOORING, NEW CABINETS, AND NEW ROOFING.

 BASEMENT WATERPROOFING. NO UNDERPINNING IS PROPOSED.
ALL WORK WILL BE DONE ACCORDING TO BALTIMORE CITY CODE AND PER THE SUBMITTED PLANS. A SEPARATE PERMIT WILL BE PULLED FOR ANY MEP WORK. NO STRUCTURAL DEMOLITION IS INCLUDED UNDER THIS PERMIT.
ALL WORK WILL BE PERFORMED IN ACCORDANCE WITH BALTIMORE CITY CODE.

work_class:
****** for SWO: Exterior Brick Repointing – 18,000 SF ******

SCOPE OF WORK:
 ------ EXTERIOR ALTERATIONS ------
 - Repoint approximately 18,000 square feet of existing exterior brick masonry. Work shall include removal of deteriorated mortar joints to the required depth, cleaning of joints, installation of new mortar compatible with the existing masonry, replacement of damaged or deteriorated bricks as required, and final cleaning of the masonry surfaces. All work shall be performed in accordance manufacturer specifications, and the current Baltimore City Building Code.
   AS PER PLANS AND AS PER CODE.

 ***** Prior to the commencement of work, a Lead Inspection/Risk Assessment shall be completed as required. Environmental dust control measures shall be implemented throughout the project, including containment, dust suppression, debris management, and proper disposal of construction waste in compliance with all applicable Baltimore City, Maryland Department of the Environment (MDE), EPA, and OSHA regulations. *******
  ******* The work is limited to exterior masonry restoration and shall not alter the structural integrity, occupancy classification, or use of the building. *****
